title: Asymptotic Level-One Fourier Weight Bound
statement: For each natural number $n$, let $f_n:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be a Boolean function, and suppose all its singleton Fourier coefficients are equal. For every $\varepsilon>0$, for all sufficiently large $n$, its level-one Fourier weight is at most $2/\pi+\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function $f_n$ is given in every dimension $n$
For every $n$, all singleton Fourier coefficients of $f_n$ are equal
